text:
Liam (docs): quick check-in — we're running a dry-run announcement for retiring the old /v1/invoke. goal: soft notice, clear migration checklist, and a tiny compatibility shim example. proposing a staging window: July 8-12 for internal dry-run, public notice July 15.

Sana (sdk): I can produce a one-file migration helper (rwd-migrate) and a JS snippet that preserves common fields. will call out metadata and custom headers.

Priya (prodops): we need to document the graceful fallback behavior: if exact model@sha is absent, route to alias and log a dimension-mismatch metric. also add an SLO note for 95th pct latency during canary.

Marco (policy): I'll review the notice language for regulatory customers. ask: should we include an explicit data-retention impact line? if not, some compliance teams will flag it.

Liam (docs): good point — add: "no stored customer data will be moved or deleted as part of the API change". also include an enterprise contact path for Dedicated customers.

Sana (sdk): draft snippet (minimal) — shows mapping plus an opt-in header for compatibility mode.

Sana (sdk): ```js
// migrate example (v1 -> v2)
// v1 body: { model: "rwd-base", input: "...", user_id: "u123" }
const v1 = { model: "rwd-base", input: "Hi", user_id: "u123" };
const v2 = {
  model: v1.model + "@latest",
  input: v1.input,
  user: v1.user_id,
  compat: true // opt-in server to preserve legacy tokenization where possible
};
client.responses.create(v2, { headers: { 'X-Compat-Mode': '1' } });
```

Liam (docs): nice. add a note: using @latest is an example; recommend pinning to model@2024-06-01 for deterministic output.

Priya (prodops): can we document a smoke-test checklist for customers: 1) confirm tokenization counts, 2) validate embedding dims, 3) run 50 sample prompts and compare outputs. include a tiny tool command: `rwd-migrate test --samples 50`.

Sana (sdk): adding curl example for ops and a warning about embed dims changing when using alias fallback.

Sana (sdk): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Compat-Mode: 1" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-base@2024-06-01","input":"Hi","user":"u123"}'
```

Marco (policy): confirmed adding retention line. also request: include a short FAQ entry about contractually pinned Dedicated customers — we should not auto-migrate them.

deploy-bot: Staging rollout scheduled -> https://deploys.redwood.ai/rollouts/789 (window: 2024-07-08..2024-07-12).

Liam (docs): plan for docs PR: short notice + migration guide + checklist + CLI tool link + SDK snippet. opening draft now. @Sana please paste final helper in the PR. @Marco I'll ping you the enterprise FAQ draft.

Sana (sdk): will push helper and unit-tests by EOD. note: edge-case when metadata contains base64 blobs — add a short note to avoid automatic inline migration.

Priya (prodops): I'll update runbook and Console banner text. recommend banner go live July 10 for 5 days before public notice.

Liam (docs): timeline summary: Sana -> helper & snippets (EOD), Marco -> enterprise FAQ (48h), Priya -> runbook & banner (by July 1), Liam -> PR publish (July 5). thanks all. :white_check_mark:
